_readme.offset: Where the wing sits, as [x, y] in canvas units from centered (+x right, +y down). The same offset applies in the logo canvas and in the favicon. [0, 0] = centered in both.
_readme.favicon_fill: Share of the favicon side taken by the wing's width (0-1). The rest is the safe area that keeps it clear of the rounded corners.
_readme.favicon_corner_radius: Rounded corners of the favicon, as a fraction of the side. 0 = square.
